The structure of Li4Al2Cr2O12 (reduced formula Li2AlCrO6) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Al, Cr, and Li centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (one Al, one Cr, two Li). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Al and Li octahedra and between Cr and Li octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between Li octahedra.
